findings.title: On Windows 11, 3 engine and daemon tests fail at the new version that pass at 0.1.5
findings.what: One run of each version on a shared Windows 11 workstation with a hard disk: test/cli/audit-cli.test.ts: rerail scan and settings CLI > fails a repository scan where a rule finds more than it may report on a file, w (Error: Test timed out in 30000ms. If this is a long-running ); test/daemon/native-session-server.test.ts: NativeSessionServer request boundary > retires an abandoned session and closes its session store resources aft (Error: Test timed out in 30000ms. If this is a long-running ); test/runtime/daemon-control/daemon-home.test.ts: the daemons of a Rerail home > leaves a daemon started beside a busy one to exit, and keeps the record and the (AssertionError: expected undefined to match object { pid: 47). Two are 30-second timeouts and one a daemon-record assertion; none was repeated, so a slow disk may explain the timeouts. No test fails at 0.1.5 only (0).
findings.severity: medium: one run each, not repeated
